parts.name: Mirror
parts.Basic_description: This is a mirror panel attached to the front of the storage cabinet, made of glass.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a reflective surface for personal grooming or decorative purposes.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It supports all other components, including shelves, mirror, and connectors, providing rigidity and storage space.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the main body of the furniture.

parts.name: Connector (Other)
parts.Basic_description: This is a small metallic connector used to join cabinet parts together, made of steel.
parts.Functional_description: It ensures structural stability by fastening the mirror and frame securely.
parts.Movement_description: It does not move during normal use but may be adjusted or removed during assembly or maintenance.
